title: Functional-group recurrence and reaction role
statement: A functional group is a retained atom-or-group subcarrier whose complete local structure recurs across molecular embeddings and carries a characteristic generated reaction role within a declared context.
generation_rule: Generate the literal product of the eight registered binary coordinates; decide every form by complete carrier preservation, exact equivalence enumeration, minimality and absence of an extra rule.
grammar_boundary: Every finite molecular carrier with complete named substructures, boundary bonds and generated source-bound reaction traces.

choices.name: isolated-fragment
choices.reason: A functional group acts in a molecule.

choices.name: molecular-embedding-held
choices.reason: Boundary bonds and context remain explicit.

choices.name: recurs-across-molecules
choices.reason: The same complete subtrace appears in multiple carriers.

choices.name: characteristic-reaction-role
choices.reason: The subcarrier maps through a generated reaction family.

choices.name: group-identity-retained
choices.reason: Atoms and boundary bonds remain held.

choices.name: substructure-and-reaction-trace
choices.reason: Every embedding and transition is retained.

choices.name: free-functional-taxonomy
choices.reason: An imported list selects the group.

choices.name: no-extra-rule
choices.reason: Recurrent structure and reaction role supply the class.

induction_base: One recurrent substructure with one retained reaction role supplies the first functional group.
induction_step: Appending a molecular embedding preserves the group trace and adds its context-bound reaction occurrence.
exclusions: no stereochemical dictionary, organic reaction taxonomy, polymer table, biomolecular database, measured target or V2 answer may select a candidate
no numerical zero, negative, irrational, imaginary or floating proof quantity
no free, fitted, learned or target-derived parameter
no atom, bond, orientation, repeat unit, chain or observation distinction may be created, copied or silently erased
absence is an Empty structural form rather than numerical zero
external target content remains inaccessible until the prediction is sealed
Every finite molecular carrier with complete named substructures, boundary bonds and generated source-bound reaction traces.

target_rows.source_locator: authority source set anchored at F02555

falsification_condition: The claim fails if authority evidence lacks an atom/group, characteristic behavior, recurrence, reaction role or context boundary, or if a tampered row is accepted.
